payload.last_assistant_message:
All syntax checks pass. Here's a summary:

- **`studio/src/utils.js`** — Added `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)`: strips trailing `-N` suffix to get a stem, returns the base title if no collision, otherwise increments until a unique title is found.
- **`studio/src/editor-panel.js`** — `showClone()` now sets `this.titleClone = this.fragment?.title ?? ''` so the value is populated even when the user accepts without typing.
- **`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`** — Same `titleClone` pre-population in its `showClone()`.
- **`studio/src/mas-repository.js`** — `copyFragment` now computes `effectiveTitle`, collects existing titles scoped to the same folder path, calls `generateUniqueTitle`, and uses the deduplicated result. Import updated to include `generateUniqueTitle`.
- **`studio/test/utils.test.js`** — 6 unit tests added covering: no collision, empty list, `-1` suffix, `-2` suffix, strip-and-re-increment, and `Set` input.

**5 files changed, 60 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-)**
